background.description: The page ground every shell sits on, the rail and the top bar included.

background-dark.description: The page ground every shell sits on, the rail and the top bar included. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

card.description: Panels, the inspector, the question card, the plan, and every text field, whatever it sits on.

card-dark.description: Panels, the inspector, the question card, the plan, and every text field, whatever it sits on. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

popover.description: The raised surface as what floats takes it: menus, popovers, selects, dialogs and sheets, on the one floating shadow.

popover-dark.description: The raised surface as what floats takes it: menus, popovers, selects, dialogs and sheets, on the one floating shadow. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

muted.description: Hover, group headers, code, the on-air readout, a segmented track, the current rail item, and the default chip.

muted-dark.description: Hover, group headers, code, the on-air readout, a segmented track, the current rail item, and the default chip. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

accent.description: shadcn's hover wash, the same value as --muted, not the signal.

accent-dark.description: shadcn's hover wash, the same value as --muted, not the signal. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

foreground.description: Running text in full ink, and the card, popover, accent and secondary foregrounds.

foreground-dark.description: Running text in full ink, and the card, popover, accent and secondary foregrounds. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

muted-foreground.description: Captions, help lines, timestamps, unchosen segmented items, and a call number at rest.

muted-foreground-dark.description: Captions, help lines, timestamps, unchosen segmented items, and a call number at rest. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

border.description: The 1px rules inside real tables and the landing page’s interface fragments (data-ui), nowhere else.

border-dark.description: The 1px rules inside real tables and the landing page’s interface fragments (data-ui), nowhere else. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

input.description: Inputs, checkboxes, radios, outlined chips and the chosen segmented item: 3:1 on the tone step too.

input-dark.description: Inputs, checkboxes, radios, outlined chips and the chosen segmented item: 3:1 on the tone step too. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

primary.description: The ink fill of a screen's one primary button, and an open call number.

primary-dark.description: The ink fill of a screen's one primary button, and an open call number. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

primary-foreground.description: Text on the primary action and on an open call number.

primary-foreground-dark.description: Text on the primary action and on an open call number. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

secondary.description: The tone fill of a secondary button, and inline code on the reading pages.

secondary-dark.description: The tone fill of a secondary button, and inline code on the reading pages. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

secondary-foreground-dark.description: Text on a secondary button. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

signal.description: What the agent puts forward, and that it's live: finalist marks and meters, the plan's lines, the on-air dot while a run is live. Never on chrome, never a whole button in the app, never success or approval. The landing page's closing band is the one colour field.

signal-dark.description: What the agent puts forward, and that it's live: finalist marks and meters, the plan's lines, the on-air dot while a run is live. Never on chrome, never a whole button in the app, never success or approval. The landing page's closing band is the one colour field. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

signal-foreground-dark.description: Text on signal orange. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

signal-ink.description: A climber's ▲ in the Move column, at 600.

signal-ink-dark.description: A climber's ▲ in the Move column, at 600. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

signal-tint-dark.description: A finalist row's wash. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

destructive.description: A failure's word and square ✕, a destructive button's outline, an invalid field's outline, and the verb's fill inside its confirm.

destructive-dark.description: A failure's word and square ✕, a destructive button's outline, an invalid field's outline, and the verb's fill inside its confirm. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

destructive-foreground-dark.description: Text on the destructive-solid button. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

ring.description: One focus ring for every control: 2px, 2px off.

ring-dark.description: One focus ring for every control: 2px, 2px off. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

scrim.description: Under a modal dialog, alert dialog or modal sheet; the inspector’s sheet is non-modal and has none.

scrim-dark.description: Under a modal dialog, alert dialog or modal sheet; the inspector’s sheet is non-modal and has none. The value under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

caption.purpose: Table meta lines, field help, timestamps, chips (12px). Takes its weight from the element: 400, 500 or 600.

ui.purpose: The app's body: app text, controls, table cells, nav (14px). Takes its weight from the element.

body.purpose: Marketing and docs text (16px). Takes its weight from the element.

title.purpose: The question's legend, fit chart ranks, docs h2, and a page's h1 in the app.

display.purpose: Marketing headings, auth and docs h1.

poster.purpose: The landing h1 only, a two-line statement across the page. Under 768px it is 17vw at 0.9 leading.

index.purpose: The landing re-rank's show names only.

show-name.purpose: A show's name in a ranked list: the fit chart, the roster, the inbox's pitch lists and the launches table (text-[15px] leading-snug font-semibold).

mono.purpose: The platform stack, for real code and codes only: code blocks, API keys and their prefixes, call numbers (C-21), insertion order IDs (IO-0001), entity IDs, recovery codes.

shadows.name: float
shadows.token: --float-shadow (shadow-float; shadow-md to shadow-2xl all resolve to it)
shadows.purpose: The one shadow, on what floats: menus, popovers, selects, dialogs, sheets. A faint ring and one shadow; in dark, a light ring and a deeper shadow, so what floats stands off the dark ground. Nothing at rest casts a shadow: shadow-2xs, shadow-xs and shadow-sm are zeroed.

motion.name: ease-swap
motion.purpose: The default easing (--default-transition-timing-function), at 150ms: presses, hovers, menus, dialogs and sheets.

motion.name: ease-lift
motion.purpose: Entrances: the masked headline, rise-in, and the landing page’s section entrances.

motion.name: re-rank
motion.purpose: Rows travel to their new places: a FLIP on the fit chart's rows, CSS translate on the landing page (whole rows, which share one height).

motion.name: live
motion.value: live 1.6s ease-in-out infinite (opacity 1 to 0.35 and back)
motion.purpose: The on-air dot while a run is running or waiting on a person; never its size.

motion.name: line-up
motion.purpose: The landing hero's masked headline: each line rises from behind its baseline (translateY 105%), only with motion allowed.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: What follows the headline rises into place from 12px down and opacity 0.

motion.name: section-entrance
motion.value: opacity 700ms and translate 900ms on ease-lift, from 32px down; a second part 80ms behind
motion.purpose: client/reveal.ts holds a landing page part until it is in view. Without the script every part is in place.

motion.name: does-names
motion.purpose: From 1280px, the name of the 'What it does' block crossing the middle of the window is in ink, the others in secondary text.

motion.name: floating
motion.value: dialogs, alert dialogs and menus: fade and scale from 0.98 over 150ms on ease-swap; selects: fade and zoom from 0.95 over 100ms; sheets: fade and slide 40px over 200ms, the scrim fading over 150ms
motion.purpose: What floats opens and closes as feedback, never as a show.

motion.name: spinner
motion.purpose: A running step shows a small spinner, never shimmering text; a skeleton is a still block with no pulse.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every animation and transition ends at once on its final state, and every piece of content is visible without JavaScript.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Tailwind's sm, for local adjustments (dialog footers, the docs' pages, the guide, the recovery code); under 640px a reference table folds into blocks (table-fold).

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Under it, the phone layout: the rail is a bottom bar, controls are 44px tall, wide tables scroll inside themselves, and the marketing nav folds into a Menu.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: 24px gutters; two-column auth, new-network and settings layouts; the dashboard's 320px column; the docs' nav beside the article.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: The landing page's 'What it does' holds its names at the left while the blocks pass.

breakpoints.name: inspector
breakpoints.purpose: min-[85rem]: the inspector sits beside the canvas, a 360px column, instead of in a sheet. At 1440, 56 (rail) + 24 + 976 (canvas) + 24 + 360 (inspector) = 1440.

breakpoints.name: docs-toc
breakpoints.purpose: min-[90rem]: the docs' On this page column.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Flat, one ink fill, 6px: a screen's one primary action, such as Answer, Approve or New launch. Never signal orange.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition-property: color, background-color, border-color; transition-duration: 150ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); background: var(--primary, #121318); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-primary:active { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #121318); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; } @media (width < 48rem) { .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; } } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, #121318) 85%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The tone fill, for every other action beside the primary, such as Export CSV. There's no outline variant: where shadcn asks for one, use secondary or ghost.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition-property: color, background-color, border-color; transition-duration: 150ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); background: var(--secondary, #e8e9ee); color: var(--secondary-foreground, #121318); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #121318); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; } @media (width < 48rem) { .ds-btn-secondary { height: 44px; } } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary[aria-expanded="true"] { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--secondary, #e8e9ee), var(--foreground, #121318) 7%); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No fill until hovered, then the tone step: Edit lines, Dismiss, Run log, a row menu.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition-property: color, background-color, border-color; transition-duration: 150ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #121318); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #121318); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; } @media (width < 48rem) { .ds-btn-ghost { height: 44px; } } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost[aria-expanded="true"] { background: var(--muted, #efeff3); }

components.name: Link Button
components.description: A button that reads as a link in a line of text: ink at 500, underlined at 1px, 2px on hover, at the line's own height.
components.css: .ds-btn-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: auto; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #121318); font: 500 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition-property: color, background-color, border-color; transition-duration: 150ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-btn-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #121318); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (width < 48rem) { .ds-btn-link { padding: 12px 0; margin: -12px 0; } }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: A crimson outline for a destructive action outside its confirm, such as Remove key or Delete network; it always opens the one confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition-property: color, background-color, border-color; transition-duration: 150ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); border-color: var(--destructive, #c8153e); background: transparent; color: var(--destructive, #c8153e); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #121318); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-destructive:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; } @media (width < 48rem) { .ds-btn-destructive { height: 44px; } } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive, #c8153e) 10%, transparent); }

components.name: Destructive Solid Button
components.description: The crimson fill, only for the verb inside its confirm, beside Keep.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive-solid { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition-property: color, background-color, border-color; transition-duration: 150ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); background: var(--destructive, #c8153e); color: var(--destructive-foreground, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-destructive-solid:active { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-btn-destructive-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #121318); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-destructive-solid:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; } @media (width < 48rem) { .ds-btn-destructive-solid { height: 44px; } } .ds-btn-destructive-solid:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive, #c8153e) 90%, transparent); }

components.name: Chips
components.description: 20px chips at caption size: tone-filled (default), outlined at the controls' 3:1 (outline), and crimson (destructive), as a pitched work's match chip uses them (Inbox.tsx).
components.html: Matched Not in Qloo Lookup failed
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; width: fit-content; height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--muted, #efeff3); color: var(--foreground, #121318); font: 500 12px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; } .ds-chip-outline { background: transparent; border-color: var(--input, #868995); } .ds-chip-destructive { background: transparent; border-color: var(--destructive, #c8153e); color: var(--destructive, #c8153e); }

components.name: Source Chips
components.description: Where a figure or line came from, never alike: Qloo data is an outlined chip with an ink square, Agent a tone-filled chip with a circle (Source.tsx). Finalist carries the signal dot. The glyphs are CSS, so screen readers don't read them.
components.html: Qloo data Agent Finalist
components.css: .ds-src { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--foreground, #121318); font: 500 12px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-src::before { content: ''; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-src-qloo { border-color: var(--input, #868995); } .ds-src-qloo::before { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--foreground, #121318); } .ds-src-agent { background: var(--muted, #efeff3); } .ds-src-agent::before { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--foreground, #121318); } .ds-src-finalist { background: var(--muted, #efeff3); } .ds-src-finalist::before { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--signal, #e4630c); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: On the card whatever it sits on, outlined at --input's 3:1, 32px tall (44px under 768px, with 16px text so iOS doesn't zoom), crimson once aria-invalid.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="Released launch" placeholder="The Big Picture" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 272px; min-width: 0; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #868995); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--foreground, #121318); font: 400 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition-property: color, background-color, border-color; transition-duration: 150ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #5f626d); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #121318); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--destructive, #c8153e); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (width < 48rem) { .ds-input { height: 44px; font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Options side by side on a tone-step track, the chosen one raised onto the card with the 3:1 outline, so it reads apart without colour: the fit chart's lens, the inspector's tabs, the budget's unit.
components.html: Rank the roster
components.css: .ds-seg-field { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; min-width: 0; } .ds-seg-legend { margin-bottom: 8px; padding: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, #5f626d); font: 400 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 32px; max-width: 100%; padding: 2px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--muted, #efeff3); } .ds-seg-item { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; min-width: 0; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #5f626d); font: 500 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition-property: color, background-color, border-color; transition-duration: 150ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-seg-item:hover { color: var(--foreground, #121318); } .ds-seg-item:has(:checked) { border-color: var(--input, #868995); background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--foreground, #121318); } .ds-seg-item input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-seg-item:has(:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #121318); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (width < 48rem) { .ds-seg { height: 44px; } .ds-seg-item { height: 40px; } }

components.name: Call Number
components.description: Every Qloo figure cites its call: a mono button with a dotted underline that opens the inspector's Evidence tab, in ink while its evidence is open (aria-pressed).
components.html: <button class="ds-call" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Evidence for the fit ranking: call C-21">C-21</button> <button class="ds-call" aria-pressed="true" aria-label="Evidence for the demographic check: call C-22">C-22</button>
components.css: .ds-call { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, #5f626d); font: 400 12px/1.333 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: dotted; text-underline-offset: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition-property: color, background-color, border-color; transition-duration: 150ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-call:hover { background: var(--muted, #efeff3); color: var(--foreground, #121318); } .ds-call[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--primary, #121318); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); text-decoration-line: none; } .ds-call:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #121318); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: State Line
components.description: StateLine (states.tsx): a glyph, the state's word in bold, then what it's about, the same everywhere. Working has the spinner, Slow Qloo a clock, Failed and Error a crimson square ✕, Missed a muted dashed circle; empty is muted text alone. A state never relies on its colour.

No roster yet.
components.css: .ds-state { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--foreground, #121318); font: 400 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-state b { font-weight: 600; } .ds-glyph { display: inline-block; width: 1em; height: 1em; margin-right: 6px; vertical-align: -0.15em; } .ds-state[data-state="failed"] .ds-glyph, .ds-state[data-state="failed"] b, .ds-state[data-state="error"] .ds-glyph, .ds-state[data-state="error"] b { color: var(--destructive, #c8153e); } .ds-state[data-state="empty"] { color: var(--muted-foreground, #5f626d); } .ds-spin { animation: ds-spin 1s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-spin { animation: none; } }

components.name: On-air Readout
components.description: Every run's on-air readout (Frame.tsx), read like a studio's on-air light: a strip on the tone step with the dot, the run's word, the current step, and while it runs the time since it started, outside the live region. The dot is signal orange and breathes while running or waiting, ink once ended; a failure shows the square ✕ and its word instead.
components.html:
RunningScoring 15 shows against The Watch · step 2
1:05
Completed
Stopped at a limit
components.css: .ds-readout { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; column-gap: 12px; row-gap: 4px; min-height: 40px; margin-bottom: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--muted, #efeff3); color: var(--foreground, #121318); font: 400 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-readout-status { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; column-gap: 12px; row-gap: 4px; min-width: 0; } .ds-onair { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-onair b, .ds-fail b { font-weight: 600; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--foreground, #121318); } .ds-dot-live { background: var(--signal, #e4630c); animation: ds-live 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-live { 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot-live { animation: none; } } .ds-fail { color: var(--destructive, #c8153e); } .ds-glyph { display: inline-block; width: 1em; height: 1em; margin-right: 6px; vertical-align: -0.15em; } .ds-elapsed { color: var(--muted-foreground, #5f626d); } .ds-elapsed span { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-runlog { height: 28px; margin: -4px -6px -4px 0; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #121318); font: 500 14px/1.45 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Schibsted Grotesk Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition-property: color, background-color, border-color; transition-duration: 150ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-runlog:hover { background: var(--muted, #efeff3); } .ds-runlog:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #121318); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Crossfeed's output is a ranked list: a network's own shows, ranked by who listens instead of by topic. So on each screen the biggest block answers the screen's one question, and on the screens about a launch that answer is the roster ranked by listener overlap. The agent, its questions and the plan serve that ranking. The data is the design, after mkdir.directory's ranked index, where the names are set larger than the headline.

The signature is the re-rank: one list switching between "By topic", what a topic-only plan picks (Claude ranks it from names and descriptions, with no Qloo data), and "By who listens", Qloo's listener overlap, with the rows travelling to their new places and the climbers marked ▲ in the Move column. It's the landing page's one live thing, a made-up roster labelled an illustration, and the fit chart's lens in the app, on the real ranking.

Every run (a launch run or a pitch run) has an on-air readout, read like a studio's on-air light: a strip on the tone step with a dot, the run's word (Running, Waiting on you, Completed, Stopped at a limit, Failed), the current step ("Scoring 15 shows against The Watch · step 2"), and while it runs the time since it started. The dot is signal orange and breathes while the run is running or waiting on a person, ink once it has ended, an empty ring before the first run; a failure shows the square ✕ and its word instead.

The identity carries past the launch page: the dashboard's rows carry the on-air dot and a finalist meter, and the roster and the inbox's ranked lists use the fit chart's row anatomy.
keyCharacteristics: On each screen the biggest block answers the screen's one question, and on the screens about a launch that answer is the roster ranked by listener overlap.
The signature is the re-rank: one list switching between "By topic" and "By who listens", with the rows travelling to their new places and the climbers marked ▲ in the Move column.
Every run has an on-air readout, read like a studio's on-air light.
One family, Schibsted Grotesk (variable, OFL); mono only for real code and codes.
Signal orange means "what the agent puts forward, and that it's live".
Nothing at rest casts a shadow; only what floats gets shadow-float.
The app follows the system's light or dark setting; there's no .dark class and no toggle.

rules.name: No decoration
rules.body: No gradients, glows, glass, backdrop blur, emoji, decorative icons, icons in tinted squares, eyebrows, tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels, KPI tiles or rows of identical icon cards. Only what floats (menus, popovers, selects, dialogs, sheets) casts a shadow.

rules.name: Mono only for codes
rules.body: Mono only for real code and codes: code blocks, API keys and their prefixes, call numbers (C-21), insertion order IDs (IO-0001), entity IDs, recovery codes. Ranks, scores, money and counts are in the text face, with tabular-nums only on bare integers that align in a column (ranks, counts, slots).

rules.name: Rank numbers are data
rules.body: Rank numbers are data, so ranked lists show them; nothing else is numbered ("Step 2 of 5" only beside a real <ol>).

rules.name: Rules only in tables
rules.body: 1px rules only inside real tables, forms and their control outlines, and the landing page's interface fragments (data-ui). Elsewhere blocks are separated by space or a tone step.

rules.name: Sentence case
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere, one h1 a page, headlines at most two lines.

rules.name: Full ink
rules.body: Running text is in full ink: 16px on marketing and docs pages, 14px in the app, nothing under 12px.

rules.name: Icons with a function
rules.body: Icons only where they carry function: chevrons, close, copy, upload, check, a state's glyph, and one 18px icon for each rail destination.

rules.name: Signal orange
rules.body: Signal orange means "what the agent puts forward, and that it's live": finalist marks and meters, the plan's lines, climbers' moves, the on-air dot while a run is live. It's never on chrome, never a whole button in the app, and never success or approval, which is an ink check and the word. The landing page's closing band is the one colour field.

rules.name: Failure leads with its word
rules.body: A failure never relies on colour: it leads with its word, and its glyph is a square ✕ where the live dot is a circle.

rules.name: Radius by role
rules.body: rounded-lg (6px) is for controls: buttons, inputs, chips, segmented controls. rounded-xl (8px) is for panels, menus, popovers, dialogs and sheets. rounded-sm and rounded-md (4px) are for items inside a menu and inline code. Only the live dot and avatars are rounded-full. Edit a component's recipe rather than overriding a radius per use.

rules.name: Flat panels
rules.body: Panels are --card on --background, or the tone step on the card, with no border and no shadow.

rules.name: The phone target is in the recipes
rules.body: Under 768px every button size, the input, the input group and the select trigger are 44px tall, and a segmented track is 44px with 40px items. Don't add max-md:h-11 per use; change the recipe.

dos: Edit a component's recipe rather than overriding a radius per use.
Every figure says where it came from, and the two never look alike: "Qloo data" is an outlined chip with an ink square, "Agent" a tone-filled chip with a circle (Source.tsx).
Every block has its loading, empty, error, pending and disabled states.
Loading uses a Skeleton in the block's real shape beside its state line.
Read the shadcn rules for a component before adding one, add only what a surface needs, and set a floating one's radius to 8px when you do.
Any floating component (menu, popover, dialog, sheet, select, tooltip, toast) is checked under the production policy before it ships.
Every animation has a reduced-motion state, and nothing is hidden without JavaScript.
donts: No gradients, glows, glass, backdrop blur, emoji, decorative icons, icons in tinted squares, eyebrows, tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels, KPI tiles or rows of identical icon cards.
There's no outline variant: where shadcn asks for one, use secondary or ghost.
Don't add max-md:h-11 per use; change the recipe.
Don't re-add one with shadcn add <name> --overwrite: edit the fork, or its recipe in variants.ts.
No sonner, which injects a <style>; use Base UI's toast if a toast is ever needed. Don't turn on Base UI's renderBeforeHydration.
A running step shows a small spinner, never shimmering text, and a skeleton is a still block with no pulse.
